changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO currency (id, code, name) SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(MAX(id), 0) + 1 FROM currency), 'SAR', 'Saudi Riyal' WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM currency WHERE code = 'SAR') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM currency WHERE name = 'Saudi Riyal'); UPDATE currency SET code = 'SAR' WHERE name = 'Saudi Riyal' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM currency WHERE code = 'SAR');
